leave_behind.text: When a mechanism-attribution dispatch names two candidate causes for a coverage gap, always cross-reference the RAW ingest table against the GATE-VISIBLE served table before assuming either named mechanism is exhaustive -- a bake-timing gap between the two is a real, distinct, and apparently recurring third cause in this pipeline (Bastrop's 17/26 here) that neither 'unwired layer' nor 'filter defect' framing anticipates.

An attribute-ID cross-reference (matching a live GIS layer's own PROP_ID field textually against internal prop_id) is NOT equivalent to the actual point-in-polygon test this pipeline performs, and can produce false negatives -- Elgin_Zoning layer 0's PROP_ID values carry an 'R' prefix baked from Bastrop CAD's own scheme, but the real ingest never joins on that field at all; it point-in-polygons parcel centroids against polygon geometry, so a parcel can validly match a polygon whose own PROP_ID differs from the parcel's (confirmed live: parcel 48021:13058 matched polygon R13064, not R13058).

As of 2026-09-08: Elgin_Zoning FeatureServer layer 0 (Bastrop side) = 3,220 features, layerWhere filter matches all of them, single distinct CITY_LIMIT value 'ELGIN'. Layer 1 (Travis side) = 500 features, 499 CITY_LIMIT='ELGIN' + 1 blank. Both layers' Zone_Code domain: R-1/R-2/R-3/A(->R-4)/C-1/C-2/C-3/I.
